On return the rear window glass was broken and the cash bag was missing. CCTV shows two men on a motorcycle who had followed the car from the bank. One is identified as Vikram Solanki alias Vicky.
mo_summary: Victim followed from the bank after withdrawing cash; rear window glass of the parked car broken in the afternoon and the cash bag lifted by two men on a motorcycle.

occurrence.place: Ring Road near textile market, Surat

narrative: Complainant, a textile trader, withdrew Rs 4,20,000 from the bank for wage payment and parked his car near the market in the afternoon. Within ten minutes the side window glass was broken and the bag with cash taken. Two persons on a motorcycle were seen following him from the bank. Fingerprint on the door matched Vikrambhai Solanki.
mo_summary: Trader followed from the bank after cash withdrawal; side window glass of the parked car broken in the afternoon and the cash bag taken by two persons on a motorcycle.

narrative: તા. 23/06/2026 ના રોજ બપોરે ફરિયાદીએ બેંકમાંથી રૂ. 3,00,000 રોકડા ઉપાડી થેલો પોતાની કારમાં મૂક્યો હતો. કાર પાર્ક કરી દવા લેવા ગયા ત્યારે બાઇક પર આવેલા બે ઇસમોએ કારનો કાચ તોડી રોકડનો થેલો ચોરી લીધો. CCTV માં બંને ઇસમો બેંકથી પીછો કરતા દેખાય છે. એક ઇસમની ઓળખ V. Solanki ઉર્ફે વિકી તરીકે થઈ છે.
mo_summary: Elderly victim followed from the bank after withdrawing cash; window glass of the parked car broken in the afternoon and the cash bag stolen by two men on a motorcycle.

narrative: Complainant withdrew Rs 8,00,000 cash from the bank and parked his car on Yagnik Road in the afternoon. The accused, who followed him from the bank on a motorcycle, broke the front window glass with a catapult and steel ball and lifted the cash bag. Both are seen in CCTV footage.
mo_summary: Victim followed from the bank after withdrawing cash; window glass of the parked car broken with a catapult in the afternoon and the cash bag lifted by two men on a motorcycle.

narrative: Complainant withdrew Rs 5,00,000 from the bank and parked his car near Delhi Gate in the afternoon. Two men on a motorcycle who followed him from the bank broke the window glass and took the cash bag. Traffic police caught both accused at a checkpoint with the bag, a catapult and steel balls.
mo_summary: Victim followed from the bank after cash withdrawal; window glass of the parked car broken in the afternoon and the cash bag taken; accused caught on a motorcycle with a catapult.

narrative: Complainant withdrew Rs 2,50,000 cash from the bank and parked his car at the market in the afternoon. The window glass was broken and the cash bag stolen. Accused Mahesh Thakor, who followed him from the bank on a motorcycle, was caught by the public.
mo_summary: Victim followed from the bank after withdrawing cash; window glass of the parked car broken in the afternoon and the cash bag stolen by a man on a motorcycle.

complainant.name: Partner of a scrap trading firm

narrative: Accused, employed as a cashier, did not deposit sale proceeds of Rs 3,40,000 collected from customers over two months and stopped coming to work.
mo_summary: Cashier collected sale proceeds from customers and did not deposit them with the firm.

narrative: Complainant parked his scooter at the market parking in the evening. When he returned after shopping the scooter was missing.

acts_sections: BNS 305 - Theft in a dwelling house
narrative: Complainant, a senior citizen living alone, found gold bangles and Rs 45,000 missing from her cupboard. The accused, employed as a cook for two months, has not come to work since and his phone is switched off.
mo_summary: Domestic help employed by an elderly woman stole gold bangles and cash from the cupboard and disappeared.
